name: silo_deposit
summary: Put things straight into an SDB Silo's store from wherever they are, each as one entry with its contents, as the silo's import stores it; by id, in part, or by a filter. Dry run by default; confirm to do it.

help.text: Each thing becomes one entry at the back of the store, with everything it holds, and is destroyed, as the silo's import does; for part of a stack only the part is stored and taken off the stack. The silo takes items whose slot class fits its import slot, up to 600 entries (an import it is saving counts). Host only.
help.keys: dry_run, silo {reference_id, prefab_name, display_name}, on_off, powered, matched, skipped, truncated, items {results, count, success_count, error_count}, count {before, after, capacity}.

forms.text: items [{reference_id, quantity}] (up to 256; quantity for part of a stack), reference_ids (whole things), or a filter over every item in the world: prefab_contains, name_contains, location, within_id, near_player_m and limit (default 64, max 600, nearest the player first). Items the silo does not take are left out of a filter and counted as skipped.

reply.text: {dry_run, silo, on_off, powered, matched, skipped, truncated, items {results [{index, ok, reference_id, prefab_name, display_name, from {id, slot}, quantity, left_in_source, children, entry}], count, success_count, error_count}, count {before, after, capacity}}. A refused thing: thing_not_found, not_movable, slot_refuses, slot_locked, planted, silo_busy (in a silo's slot), in_vault_slot, silo_full, invalid_argument (named twice, inside another thing named, more than the stack holds).

quantity.description: Part of a stack. Default all.

items.description: Things by id, each whole or part of a stack, up to 256.

prefab_contains.description: Filter: part of the prefab name, any case.

name_contains.description: Filter: part of the shown name, any case.

location.description: Filter: any, ground, player or stored (see items).

within_id.description: Filter: inside this holder at any depth (a backpack, a locker, a player).

near_player_m.description: Filter: within this many metres of the player.

limit.description: Filter: at most this many things, nearest first; default 64.

dry_run.description: Default true: check and report only.

confirm.description: true with dry_run false to deposit.
